results.title: Top 8 Best Universities for Computer Science in France in 2026 | Study.eu
results.snippet:
France has many English-taught programmes at Bachelor’s, Master’s and Doctoral level. They rank highly for Computer Science on the CSRankings scoreboard - a metrics-based ranking of top computer science institutions around the world.

Here’s an overview of the top 8: [...] Public universities are the most common option. They offer a wide range of IT degrees (Bachelors and Masters), often at low tuition fees. These universities are accessible and focus on both theory and practical skills, with many programmes taught in English. [...] If you’re considering private institutions or business schools, tuition fees can be higher, often ranging between €5,000 and €15,000 per year.

### 📝 Admissions requirements:

In addition to a high level of English, you will need to have the following ready to apply for a Computer Science programme in France:

 a cover letter,
 your CV (include relevant projects and hobbies),
 your grades from your previous education,
 references,
 in some cases, there might be entrance test or an interview.
